name: DCA-A1-04 · Product Update Broadcast (tell past buyers, safely)

parameters.content:
## 📢 Product Update Broadcast
**New version → the right buyers told once → fresh working link.**

### Setup (about 14 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → `storeName`, `fromEmail`, `downloadBaseUrl`.
2. **✍️ Sign fresh links** → the **same secret** as A1-01 and A1-02.
3. Seed `buyers` from your order log, or wire the recipient node to your
   real order source.
4. POST when you ship an update:
   ```json
   { "productId": "book-01", "version": "2.0",
     "significance": "major",
     "changes": ["...", "..."] }
   ```

### This is a revenue template, not a courtesy
A buyer who gets a free improvement six months later learns you keep your
word — which is the whole basis of the second purchase.

### 🔇 Not every change deserves an email
| significance | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `major` | everyone who bought it is told |
| `minor` | told, but low-key wording |
| `patch` | **recorded, nobody emailed** |

Mailing your whole buyer list about a typo fix is how a welcome update
becomes an unsubscribe.

The version is still recorded on `patch`, so the next major update can
mention the accumulated fixes.

### 🛡️ Four things that go wrong, prevented
1. **Wrong people** — filtered to buyers of *that* product only.
2. **Twice** — every send recorded per buyer per version, so re-running
   the job mails nobody again.
3. **Dead links** — each recipient gets a **freshly signed** link, not the
   expired one from their original purchase.
4. **Rate limits** — sent in batches.

Point 4 matters beyond this template: a provider throttling or flagging
you damages **every** email the rest of the suite sends.

### 📦 Batching
`batchSize` recipients per run. Re-POST the same update to send the next
batch — already-notified buyers are skipped automatically, so you can
simply call it again until `remaining` reaches 0.

Or schedule the same payload to repeat every few minutes and let it drain
the list by itself.

nodes.name: 🆕 Update shipped
nodes.notes: POST {productId, version, significance, changes[]} when you ship an update.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: buyers maps productId → [{email, orderId, name}]. Seed it or wire the recipient node to your order store.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 📋 Decide who to tell
nodes.notes: Filters to real buyers, skips anyone already told, batches, and stays silent on patches.

nodes.name: ✍️ Sign fresh links
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Must be the SAME secret as A1-01, A1-02 and A4-01.

nodes.name: ✍️ Compose the announcement
nodes.notes: Every recipient gets a freshly signed link, not the dead one from their purchase.

nodes.name: 📧 Send the announcement
nodes.notes: Attach SMTP. Batched upstream to protect your sending reputation.

nodes.name: ⏭️ Nothing sent
nodes.notes: A re-run lands here and does nothing, which is correct.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.

nodes.name: 📒 Broadcast log
nodes.notes: `remaining` tells you whether to call again for the next batch.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.
